breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly removed the erroneous statement from the incomplete prompt which suggested that the maximum in-plane shear was equal to the average transverse shear stress alone. The generated specification, like the ground truth, correctly instructs to calculate the maximum in-plane shear stress using the formula `τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2)`, which properly accounts for both normal and shear stress contributions.
